dedupe_keys.name: reseau routier de l isere transports exceptionnels

description: Réseau routier de l'Isère - Transports Exceptionnels is a dataset listed in Opendata Isère open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département de l'Isère. Réseau routier des transports exceptionnels sur le territoire isérois. Coverage: Isère. The portal files it under Mobilités. Its keywords are Transport Exceptionnel. The portal shows 297 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-isere-fr-portal.
